publicGates.command: node -e "const { summarizeByTeam } = require('./src/metrics'); const rows = summarizeByTeam([{ team:'A', revenueCents:1500, costCents:500 }, { team:'A', revenueCents:700, costCents:200 }, { team:'B', revenueCents:900, costCents:100 }]); const a = rows.find(r => r.team === 'A'); if (!a || a.revenueCents !== 2200 || a.costCents !== 700 || a.profitCents !== 1500) throw new Error(JSON.stringify(rows));"

node -e "const { renderSummary } = require('./src/report'); const out = renderSummary([{ team:'Blue', revenueCents:1000, costCents:200 }, { team:'Red', revenueCents:1500, costCents:1000 }]); const lines = String(out).trim().split(/\\n/); if (!/^Blue\b/.test(lines[0]) || !out.includes('profit $8.00') || !out.includes('margin 80.0%')) throw new Error(out);"

hiddenGates.command: node -e "const { normalizeRecords, summarizeByTeam } = require('./src/metrics'); const normalized = normalizeRecords([{ team:'Ops', revenueCents:'2500' }, { team:'Ops', costCents:500 }]); if (normalized[0].costCents !== 0 || normalized[1].revenueCents !== 0) throw new Error(JSON.stringify(normalized)); const [row] = summarizeByTeam(normalized); if (row.marginPct !== 80) throw new Error(JSON.stringify(row));"
